cases.title: First lesson, no layer in mind: the opening asks one thing (TD 19): intent question first, one-sentence fallback proposal with a hinge, ends on the choice; no leave-out, no idea statement, no other-skill recap

rubric.reason: The turn opens with the real question "Which layer do you want to turn or grow from somewhere other than its middle, and where should it turn from: a corner, an edge, or the middle?" before naming Door's left edge.
It offers only the snapshot's proposal, Door, with a hinge place ("Door could swing from its left edge. Want to try that one?"), and leaves the choice to the learner.
The only layer named is Door, which matches the snapshot's proposal (layer "Door", suggested_place "middle-left"), and "left edge" is that place in words.
The opening is just the intent question plus a one-sentence fallback proposal, with no leave-out, idea statement, layer list or recap, and it ends on the choice "Want to try that one?"
